Definition: from ὑφαίνω to weave; woven, i.e. (perhaps) knitted:--woven.
BiblicalUsage: The word hyphantós carries the sense of woven, knitted. In John 19:23, the text says "woven from the top throughout."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hyphantós plainly — it means woven, knitted, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
